answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 44593 Country: INDIA Title: Ghusl Question: Is ghusl obligatory if semen is discharged which is less than a dirham in size? Answer ID: 44593 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 600/354/L=1434) The discharge of semen makes ghusl wajib whether it is less than one dirham. So if the semen discharged is less than one dirham then too ghusl shall be wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
